panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: One row per opencode conversation (grouped by the x-session-affinity header opencode sends, or a fallback hash - see services.stats.recorder). There's no panel to click through into anymore: the agent loop runs in opencode on the tester's machine, not in this service.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.session_id, u.username AS "user", min(l.created_at) AS "started", max(l.created_at) AS "last_activity", count(*) AS "requests", sum(l.tokens_prompt) AS "prompt_tokens", sum(l.tokens_completion) AS "completion_tokens", sum(l.tool_call_count) AS "tool_calls", sum(l.cost_usd) AS "cost_usd", (array_agg(l.model ORDER BY l.created_at))[1] AS "first_model" FROM llm_requests l JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id GROUP BY l.session_id, u.username ORDER BY min(l.created_at) DESC LIMIT 200
